title: Empty modifier placement is skipped
goal: Explore a food-ordering journey whose selected cart line has no eligible modifier recommendation, while the conversation remains natural and can continue to later ordering needs.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-04-modifier-empty and select a product without an eligible modifier recommendation.
The published Sanity production snapshot is reachable.
The role-player responds only to customer-visible output and does not inspect technical evidence during the run.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Cho mình một món đơn giản, không cần tùy chỉnh gì thêm.

risks: An empty placement must not generate a fabricated offer.
Skipping the placement must not prevent legitimate later ordering help.
